ticket_title: Need to configured only finger on device
description_plain: For existing devices, we need to configure only finger for punching. Remove the existing database and configure for new user data New users must configure punching to use only one finger
comments:
Client is not able to provide remote today ,
Client confirm that we will discuss issue on Monday.
solution:
for the resolution of this query we have perform below steps,
1.we have asked the user to unable free scan option on device
But it is only work on  010.010.111.101 reader and free scan automatically turn off after some time.
For the further process we have perform below steps,
Step 1 > NetServer Application > File Location > NetServer Utility[11.0.0.1104] > login 
Step 2 > Select Controller > 010.010.111.101 > Get Parameter > FP Unable(Yes) > FP Compulsory(No) > Free Scan(ON) > Ideal Time (0) > Set Parameter 
Step 3 > Select Controller > 010.010.111.102 > Get Parameter > FP Unable(Yes) > FP Compulsory(No) > Free Scan(ON) > Ideal Time (0) > Set Parameter 
After performing the configuration user is still not able to punch through finger on both reader's.
So we have checked one particular Employee and found that user is not configured on both device,
Hence, we have dump all the finger's of 010.010.111.101 to 010.010.111.102
for that we have done below configuration
> Net server Application > Reader Utility > Select the reader > Dump all the Finger data to reader 010.010.111.101 & 010.010.111.102 > Proceed 
> Employee > Update Employee > Selected Both Reader > Selected all the employees > Proceed.
Now user is able to punch on both devices.

name: ARSWin-Net
ticket_title: Unbale show user name attendance data
description_plain: The Bangladesh office's Bio-Metric system is unable to show the user names; all data is shown in red colours.
comments: We have communicated with the client and found that their ID is not under AMC. Therefore, we have forwarded the issue to the AMC Team and are awaiting for further instructions.
solution:
1. We checked that, if we enter the Site Code in Employee Master in User Details, the Data is coming in the right format but the issue is we have to change the Card ID because it can only take 6 digits. 
2. We then disabled the Site Code through the following steps: Master > Reader Format > Site Code > No from Yes. 
Some users were still able to punch properly while some were not, so we dumped all the PC data on the Reader. Now, almost all users are able to punch properly. 
We have also instructed the users to check whether the Punch Data comes in red font or not showing Employee ID or Name, and to kindly Copy the Card ID and go to: Employee > Edit > Search > Employee Name or ID > Edit > enter the Card ID (8 digits). Therefore, the Card ID is now able to take 8 digits.

description_plain: Managing Finger Database and Transferring it to One Machine to another Machine
comments:
Client office is going to close at 6 Pm ,
So further process will do on Tomorrow morning.
solution:
1. We have checked how much user data is stored on all 13 devices.
Reader > Reader Utility > Select all 13 devices, one by one.> Get Status > Proceed

2. Now we have to take finger print data back up from all the devices.
Reader > Reader Utility >  Select all 13 devices, one by one.> Get Finger Parameters > Proceed

3. After that, we have cleared all the reader data.
>Reader > Reader Utility > Selected all the 13 devices (one by one) > Clear Reader Database > Proceed

4. Now we have dumped all the user data that is stored in the application on readers.
>Reader > Reader Utility > Selected all the 13 devices (one by one) > Dump PC Database to Reader > Proceed

5. Now we have to delete all the finger data from the reader because this data includes left-employee finger data.
Reader > Reader Utility >  Select all 13 devices, one by one.> Delet all Finger Templates > Proceed

6. At last, we have dumped all the active user finger data on all the devices.
Reader > Reader Utility > I chose all 13 devices one by one. Set Finger Parameter > Proceed

name: NetXsControl Ent.-100
description_plain: 1. Remove the existing database and configure for new user data. 2.New users must configure punching to use only one finger.
comments:
We have taken remote session of user and found that user wants to Re-install NetXs Control software on new  system.
For that we asked  user to install SQL on new device.
solution:
To install the NetCom Application on the new device, we performed the following steps: 
Step 1 – Install SQL on the new device. 
Step 2 – Install the NetCom Application setup on the new device. 
Step 3 – Copy all the NetCom App backup Files from the old device and copy them to the new Netcom App File location.  
Step 4 – We configured the NetCom App with the SQL Server. 
Now the user wants to configure two devices with the NetCom App. 
Step 5 – NetComm App > Add Reader > Added Two Readers (010.010.111.011 and 010.010.111.012)
Step 6 – NetComm App > Look for Master > Update Timezone > Add > Save
Step 7 – NetComm App > Reader Utility > Get Status > Process 
Step 8 – NetComm App > Reader Utility > Clear Reader Database > Process 
Step 9 – NetComm App > Reader Utility > Clear All Finger Parameters > Process 
After all the configurations, the user was asked to add a master finger to the devices. 
Now the user wants to add employees and give access only via finger. 
Step 10 – NetComm App > Employee > Add > Global Access Mode > Only Finger Mode 
All the configurations have been successfully completed.

description_plain: Dear Shubham Sir, A device made in ZAHL plant is taking punch access but the turnstile Tripod is not rotating. Please resolve this issue.
comments:

I discussed the issue with Jatin sir and he believed it to be a turnstile issue, suggesting that the user should replace the device and check again.
solution:
We checked and worked on the following details: 
1. We checked all the turnstiles and found one device displaying a 'User not found' error, and one turnstile not rotating. 
2. We needed to dump on the device, so we started the process but encountered a duplicate of 5000 commands. 
3. We stopped the command, deleted it, and checked what the actual issue was, and discussed it with the development team, before taking a stop process DLL and running it in the service.
4. After that, we dumped the process, and now the user dump process is completed and the device is working fine.

3. We needed to do a user dump on the controller, so we factory reset the device and did user dumps on the two canteen controllers one by one. 
4. After the user dump, showing a printer disconnected error so we guided the user on how to disable the BLE printer manually on the controller. 
5. After that, the canteen device was working fine, but when the user operated it, the printer printout was not generated. We discussed this with Jatin Sir and we obtained the latest firmware of the device. 
6. We updated the latest firmware to 4 canteen devices and now the device is working fine.

Finally, we went to Step 2: ARS Win > Master > Employee > Search Employee > selected Edit > then Save. 
Now the user can punch on any device through their card.

name: ARSWin-Net
ticket_title: Reports are not showing in system
description_plain: The data from the biometric device on GB-1 Tablet capsule quarantine-1 device is not appearing in the system's reports.
comments: Remote session has been interrupted.
solution:
we have taken the following steps:

1. We created a test Access Report1 to check if the same issue was occurring; unfortunately, the same error persisted. 

2. We downloaded the log of that device and found the below query: 

SELECT [code], [name], [device name], [punch date time] FROM (
    SELECT TOP 100
        [empmaster].[code] [code],
        [empmaster].[name] [name],
        [devices].[name] [device name],
        [trans].[punchdetail] [punch date time]
    FROM trans (NOLOCK)
    LEFT OUTER JOIN empmaster (NOLOCK) ON trans.empid = empmaster.id
    INNER JOIN allusers (NOLOCK) ON allusers.id = empmaster.id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN location (NOLOCK) ON location.id = trans.locationid
    LEFT OUTER JOIN company (NOLOCK) ON company.id = trans.companyid
    LEFT OUTER JOIN gatesetup (NOLOCK) ON trans.gateid = gatesetup.id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM controllermaster (NOLOCK)) devices ON trans.cid = devices.id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT id, name AS controllercompany FROM company (NOLOCK)) controllercompany ON devices.companyid = controllercompany.id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN controllertype controllertype ON devices.controllertypeid = controllertype.id
    WHERE 1 = 1
    AND [trans].[punchdetail] >= '2023-10-01'
    AND [trans].[punchdetail] <= '2023-10-11'
    AND [allusers].[locationid] = 1
    ORDER BY [punch date time] ASC
) A

We ran this query and checked whether data was showing or not; in SQL, the data was present, but in the Access Report it wasn't. 

3. We then checked Access Control > Device Operation > Database > Search the device and found that 756 transactions were pending. Following the advice of our senior, we then restarted the Spectra Worker Service and refreshed the database, to check if the number of transactions had reduced.

For now system is under observation if any issue occurred, user is informed to contact us.

description_plain: Dear Sir, VMS not working at SEZ2, screenshot attached while gate pass create.
comments:
1. We checked and found an error of unique key constraint when we tried to save the registration page on the VMS.
2. So, we checked in the database and executed the following query for the solution:
- SELECT MAX(id) FROM VISITOR   
  SELECT * FROM Sequences WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE '%visitor%'
3. When we run the query, both tables were showing a one count difference, so we updated the count from the following query:
- UPDATE Sequences SET LastSequence = '' WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE '%visitor%'
4. Now the error has been resolved and the VMS registration page data is saving properly.

2. We then check the user hierarchy to confirm that the primary and final approvals are in place, and verify in the master records that approvals have been granted.

3. We opened the employee master menu and found that all the approvals had been properly set to active employees.
4. We opened the user logs to review the activities that had been carried out by the user in the previous days and filtered the date of the application.
5. We found that the user had updated the overtime hierarchy after the employee had submitted the overtime application, thereby resulting in the application being marked as pending with HR.

description_plain: Please install the Headcount Monitoring System.
comments:
1. We began to install the security monitor at the Dabhasa location. First, we created lookups for the security monitor. 
2. Then, we created an access zone and specified the devices for it. 
3. Next, we created a general door group comprising of both inner and outer doors and selected the corresponding devices: for the inner door, access and attendance devices, and for the outer door, turnstiles installed at the main gate. 
4. After that, we created the muster setting, including the outer and inner doors, as well as the muster point. However, when we saved the muster setting details, we encountered an error of execution timeout, so we shared the error with Setul Sir. 
5. We took the server and checked its log details, and realized that the muster settings procedure was not working, which is why the error was showing. We are now waiting for the development team's response for this.
solution:
1. We take remote access from TeamViewer and set up file transfers.
2. After setting up the transfer, we install the Security Monitor Executable; it requires an Administrator ID and Password during installation, so we have to coordinate with the client and IT team to install the EXE.
3. After that, we launch the Security Monitor and open in Web Portal, copying and pasting the Web Portal link in the Security Monitor.
4. Once the link is verified, we save the link and the Security Monitor will prompt for an ID and Password to open.
5. We give rights from the User Group of Security18 ID and save it, applying an ID and Password. However, the password we are showing is wrong.
6. We change the password from the Database SQL using the following query: SELECT * FROM User Master WHERE username='security18'. 
7. After that, we log in to the Security Monitor and it is working properly now.
8. We then provide training to the user regarding headcount and the count is showing perfectly.

1. First, we check and find that the software is not open and loading continuously.
2. We log into the CITRIX server, open the Task Manager, and find that the CPU consumption has increased to 90% or above, resulting in the server hanging.
3. We first stop the Spectra Worker Service and wait for the CPU consumption to decrease.
4. Then, we stop the IIS Server and wait for 5 minutes for the CPU consumption to normalize.
5. After that, we start the IIS Server and Spectra Worker process one by one, and the server hanging issue has been resolved.
6. The software is now working fine.

description_plain: Today again we have identified error in OT, request you to please resolve OT error (Pending at system) as per attached file.
comments:
1. On checking, we found numerous overtime applications still pending in the system across all Zydus locations.
2. We verified that the user hierarchy of some employees had been defined correctly.
3. We discussed this with our development team, and then proceeded to take the Zydus server database and execute the following query:
     Query: SELECT * FROM adjustapply (nolock) WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1
            AND attddate BETWEEN '2023-08-01' AND '2023-10-19'; 
     Query: UPDATE adjustapply SET f7 = NULL  WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1
            AND attddate BETWEEN '2023-08-01' AND '2023-10-19'.
4. After executing the update query, we stopped the Spectra client process for 5 minutes, and then restarted it.
5. We restarting the service, the countdown of pending overtime applications began to clear, taking around half an hour to complete.

name: BioScribe 2C
description_plain: The Unit-2 turnstile devices are not working, so the Toshi vendor has visited the site location.
comments:
We have worked on the following steps:
1. Toshi, the turnstile vendor, visited the Daman plant, so we coordinated with him about the turnstile case.
2. We first checked Unit 1's IN-OUT turnstiles one by one by punching access and we found a turnstile cabling issue which Toshi was able to resolve.
3. After that we went to the other turnstile, Unit 2's IN-OUT, and the same issue was found, so we worked together and resolved the issue.
4. We then went to the Unit 2 turnstiles and, again, we found the same cabling issue. Toshi checked and updated us with further action.
solution:
We worked on the following steps with JatinSir to fix the issue:
1. We replaced two devices in Unit-2 with new ones and found out that the issue was caused by an improperly connected cable, making the turnstile not rotate when punched on the device.
2. We then changed the MAC address of the device and configured it, and it is now working properly.
3. For Unit-1, we replaced and configured the turnstile device, but it wasn't rotating when punched. So, we held a conference call with the Toshi Team, guided by Jatin Sir, to correct the cabling for the device.
4. As directed by the jatin sir, toshi enginner changed the Red-Black cable.
5. Upon checking all the turnstiles and their card format settings, we found that all of them are now properly working.

Furthermore, I provided training to Mr. Rakesh Patra about the canteen module, for device management, workflow and device operation.

description_plain: Overtime hierarchy – matter is yet not clear that Overtime assigner, enters his teammate’s miss-punch, Forgot card, shift change or week off change, it gets approved itself (system jumps all approvals required)
comments:
1. Discuss with client about overtime hierarchy and approval manager hiharchy.  
2. Overtime hierarchy and approval hierarchy both work on separate hierarchies, but when the overtime hierarchy primary approval applies leave for the employee, it automatically approves the leave when it works on the approval manager hierarchy.  because there is only one level defined for approval in the approval manager hierarchy.

----> How the Overtime Hierarchy Works :- The application is made by the primary manager and the application goes to the manager's manager for approval.

----> How the approval hierarchy works :- Applied by the employee and approved by the manager.

comments:

1. First we checked and found that there were 4 to 5 employees whose forgotten card applications had been approved but the punches were not showing on the spreadsheet.
2. We checked and found that the shifts were showing empty, which is why the punches weren't showing.
3. We took the Zydus database and checked one by one for shift IDs using the following query: 
SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code='138278'
SELECT * FROM AttdMain WHERE empid='138278' AND attddate='2023/10/25'
4. We found that the shift ID was showing wrong in the database and was showing -1.
5. We updated the shift ID as per the client's requirements and reprocessed the attendance, after which the attendance started showing properly. 
6. We completed this task one by one for all 5 employees and thus solved the issue.

name: iApp
description_plain: Configuration for Repaired Device.
comments: We have called the user, but they are not responding.
solution:
We have taken a remote session with the user and found that they wanted to remove the device from the canteen management and configure it for attendance. To accomplish this task, we performed the following steps: 
1. Updating the prox firmware for the device IP 10.131.82.19
2. Going to I App > Attendance > Device Management > Device > selecting the canteen device and changing the IP & Mac Address > Saving 
3. Going to I App > Attendance > Device Management > Operations > performing a Factory Reset > Saving
4. Going to I App > Attendance > Device Management > Database > Syncing > Date & Time > Users > Saving

After performing all the mentioned steps, we were unable to get the device status. Thus, we deleted the machine data via SLQ using the below queries: 
-Select * from ControllerMaster Where ipaddr in ('10.131.82.19','10.131.82.18')
-Delete * from Machinedata
-Select * From Machinedata Where Status ='p'
-Selecet * into DIVICEUTILITYSTATUS_301023 FROM  DIVICEUTILITYSTATUS

Upon getting the user status, we assigned access for all of the users by going to 
I App > Attendance > Device Management > setting the card format > Saving 
I App > Attendance > Device Management > Assigning Access > Selecting all Users and Saving.

Therefore, the user is now able to punch the attendance module device.

name: iApp
description_plain: Data is being moved to an intermediate table, despite being considered as an out-punch, it is still being inputted.
comments: Waiting for meeting link.
solution: We took a remote session of the user and found that they had a Bio Scribe 3s device for In Punch and an Xs Point Plus reader for Out Punch. However, whenever the user punches on their Bio Scribe 3s device, the system was considering it as an Out Punch. To resolve this issue, we carried out multiple trouble shooting steps and made some changes in the configuration. The changes were done in the following steps: I App > Access Control > Device Management > Devices > Selected Device > Edit > Entry Reader > Internal Door; Exit Reader > Change from Internal Door to External Door. The user is now getting the proper punching data.

name: iApp
description_plain: A unique key error has occurred while trying to save the page during visitor registration.
comments:
Find the steps below: 
1. When we open the registration page and attempt to save the gate pass, we receive an error Unique key constraint. 
2. To check the visitor count mismatch issue, we take the Zydus server and open the SQL dbx. 
3. We execute the following query in the database: 
--SELECT MAX(id) FROM VISITOR --459915 
--SELECT * FROM Sequences WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE'%visitor%' --459914
4. We find that the visitor count sequence is mismatched, so we update the sequence with the following query: 
--UPDATE SEQUENCES SET LastSequence = '' WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE'%visitor%' 
5. Now that the sequence is updated, the VMS is working properly.

After all the configurations in I App, we installed the security monitor setup and connected it with the SQL credentials. 
Now, the user is able to access the security monitor.

description_plain: Replace the device in QC2 due to a date and time issue.
comments: We discussed with the client and have arranged for the device to be replaced, and he will receive the base after the installation is completed.
solution:
1. The client needs to replace a 2C device with a 3S device.
2. First, we save the parameters of the old device and guide the client on how to remove it and install the new device.
3. As the client needs hardware support when installing, we coordinate with the hardware team to install the device.
4. After installation, we guide them to insert the device IP, gateway, and subnet mask to connect the device to the network, however, the device IP does not appear to be active.
5. We coordinate with the IT team and found out that the device LAN cable was not functioning, so they changed the cable and the device's IP showed as active.
6. After that, we open the bootloader application and set the server IP and device port, then configure the device.
7. We opened the devices and added the new device with all the parameters.
8. The device command went through successfully, so we added the device to the attendance access group.
9. Afterwards, we did a factory reset on the device and performed a user dump onto it.
10. The user dump procedure was completed, we created the 3S card format and set it on the device.
11. As this is an attendance device, we added it to the attendance settings and now the device is working properly.

As per configuration Auto permission is not granted by system due to Early hour is not calculated.

For an example employee 400003558 was coming in Gen shift and First IN is 07:51 & Last Out is 16:22 . In Early Hour column not showing in early hour due to currently configuration as per 

below:

description_plain: Request to you please segregate Boom Barrier access from other access device as soon as earlier. Boom Barrier IP- 172.24.30.139 172.24.30.192 172.24.30.193 172.24.30.82
comments:

2. We took the Zydus server and checked in CMD, finding that the device IP is showing as inactive.
3. We coordinated with the IT team, but no issues were found on the network side.

1. Firstly, we check all four boom barrier devices, of which two devices' IPs are active and working properly, while the other two are not.

5. The IT team updates the same IP to the other working device and finds that the device IP is also not working, thereby confirming that the issue is from the IT side.
6. The IT team provides us another IP, which we configure on the device, and now the device IP is active with 1800 transactions pending, so it will take time to clear all of them.
7. The other IP is still not working, so the IT team will check it out tomorrow and solve the network-related issue.

SELECT * FROM ContractWokforce WHERE Code='TOP0090000637'

9. We edited the item group that was assigned to the user and updated the item restriction count to 2.
10. Afterward the employee punched again, and now one punch is now showing in the canteen data, as well as in the software.
11. We found out that after the item group was edited and saved, the punch was able to be found, and this is indicated as a bug; hence, we escalated this case to the product development team for further help.

description_plain: The attendance devices are not active on the network and our IT team has checked both the device IP pings and verified that they are functioning properly.
comments:
1. Two attendance devices were showing inactive. Upon checking Hercules, a TCP connection failure was observed on the server.
2. We got in touch with the Power Connection team and they concluded that the power connection was functioning fine.
3. We tried to contact multiple IT personnel but were not getting any proper response.
4. We got in touch with someone from the HR team and checked the physical device parameters which were configured properly.
5. We sent an email to the client informing them that we would need some time from the IT team to check any network related issues.
solution:
We worked on the following tasks:
1. We checked to ensure that ping was working properly on both devices.
2. Then, we opened the bootloader application on the Zydus server and ensured that the device was showing correctly. 
3. We updated the device's port and MAC address in the software, edited, and saved the controller.
4. The command was not sent to the device and the software was showing it as inactive.
5. We coordinated with the IT team, who confirmed that the network was functioning correctly and that no issues were found.
6. We physically restarted the device and the command was sent successfully.
7. We saved the card format of the device, and confirmed that it was working correctly now.

name: iApp
description_plain: All of the Moraiya turnstile devices are not functioning properly.”
comments:
1. We checked and found that all turnstile devices were only showing card mode, although the user claimed that the devices had been in card+finger mode for the past month.
2. We checked the user logs but were unable to find any data about the device mode changes.
3. After that, we discussed with the client and solved the misunderstanding that the user had made mode changes in the device.
4. We had a conference call with the client in which the client required that the device mode be changed to card+finger for 24 devices.
5. We changed the mode of 16 devices for testing purposes.
solution:
1. Card+finger mode has been configured, but lots of employees' fingers are not being read.
2. We discussed with the client and told them to do live punch and we found that finger mismatches were resulting in error messages.
3. We checked in the master and got the finger module, but found that the fingers were not being read properly.
4. We guided them to properly retake the finger, telling them to only click on the left index and right index when taking an employee's finger.
5. Now it is working properly. 
6. There was another Netxcontrol issue - punches were not showing, so we guided them to select a controller on Netxsdownloading and, after selection, the pending transactions were slowly cleared.

comments:
The client has transferred the device, and we have guided them to enter the device parameters; however, the device IP is not functioning in the server.

solution:

1. The IT team connected the device to the network, but the device was not found, so we requested remote access.
2. We took Ultra Viewer and added the bootloader application to the system and started it.
3. When we searched for the device, it was visible, but when we configured the devices settings, it showed that the parameters were not set in the device.
4. We found that the laptop's IP was out of range, so with the help of Setul Sir, the IP range was defined as per the device's parameters.
5. After that, when we searched again in the bootloader and set the parameter, the same issue was encountered.
6. We took another device managing application and added it.
7. After searching for the device, it showed up properly, and we were able to configure the parameters on the device, which changed successfully.
8. We took the Zydus server and searched for the device in the bootloader, and it showed up perfectly, so we configured the device's parameter.
9. We then consulted Jatin Sir and updated the device's firmware. 
10. We then added the device to the canteen master, and the command was successfully done.
11. Afterwards, we performed a factory reset on the device and added user dumps, and set the card format.
12. The activity of configuring the device ended successfully, and the canteen device is functioning properly.

comments:
The client has transferred the device, and we have guided them to enter the device parameters; however, the device IP is not functioning in the server.

solution:
We worked on the following tasks: 
1. We checked the IP address, but it was not active on the Zydus server, so we instructed them to check the device and find that the IP address was wrong, and then guided them to change the IP address, gateway, and subnet mask on the device physically. 
2. After changing the device parameters, the IP address still wasn't working, and we got a reply from other IPs indicating destination host unreachable. 
3. We coordinated with IP and IT teams to solve the IP issue, and the device's IP is now active properly.
4. After that, we updated the firmware of the device (Bioscribe 3s).
5. We created a new device, added it to the software, and saved all the device parameters. The commands were successfully executed.
6. We performed a factory reset on the device, added it to the attendance access group, and performed user dumps on it.
7. After the user dump process was completed, we set the card format of the device and added the attendance setting module.
8. We tested live punching on the device, and the attendance device is working properly.

name: iApp
description_plain: Our Hardware Engineer, Mr. Jayesh Patel, visited the plant and needs to replace the Turnstile Devices.
comments:
1. We found an error and checked it with Jayeshbhai.
2. Turnstile 2 was not working; we checked and found that the user was showing only 1000, so we redumped on it.
3. Turnstile 1 was allowing multiple punches after a single punch, so we updated the firmware of the device. 
We noticed a card-sensing issue, when the employee punched 4 to 5 times it was sensing only one time; so, we discussed with the hardware repair team and guided Jayeshbhai to open the device and check the coil and fit it properly in the device. We resolved the issue by re-adding the coil in the sensing module.
4. After that, we dumped the user on it.
5. We replaced two Bioscribe devices and changed the MAC address in the software card format set in the device.
6. Both devices punching was working properly.
solution:
1. Two Bioscribe 2C devices had to be installed and configured, but upon checking in the server, we found that both their IPs were showing as inactive in the Zydus server.
2. After the IPs became active, we replaced the devices and changed the MAC addresses of both of them, and the commands were executed successfully.
3. An error, FP 7a, occurred while punching by finger on the third device, so we discussed the issue with the hardware team and needed to factory reset and perform user dumping on the device.
4. After user dumping, the same error, FP 7a, occurred while punching the finger, so we needed to send the device to the Spectra work station.
5. The devices were managed in an in-out mode one by one with the help of Mr. Jayesh Patel.

name: NetXsControl Ent.
description_plain: Employee access not working.
comments:
1. Upon opening the software, we find that when the user tries to assign exclusive door access, an error is displayed showing that only 100 employees are allowed.
2. We discussed the issue with Setul Sir and tried to understand the actual concern. We opened the database and checked the Employees Master table which showed 700 employees.
3. After speaking to the client, we found that this system had already crashed before and hence, no data was available in the system, only backup files were available.
4. The user had no information regarding the version of the software, so we quickly installed the normal, free Netxs version as a stop-gap measure. We later found that the previous version was Netxs Ent. version.
5. We discussed the matter with the AMC team and, with the approval of Mrigank Sir, we reinstalled the software.
6. We took remote access and first took the latest backup, then uninstalled the Netxscontrol free software. 
7. After that, they created a link to the Netxs Ent. setup on Google and shared it with the IT Team.
8. In order to open the software, we needed a new activation key as the old one was not available.
9. We coordinated with Nikunj Sir from the Admin Team to take a new activation key for Netxscontrol Ent. exe and shared the key file with the client.
solution:
After the break, we worked on the following tasks: 
1. We updated the activation key in the netxscontrol folder, opened the software and inserted SQL IDs, passwords, file paths, and server names. 
2. We created a license key file which we then shared with Nikunj Sir to get the final license key from him; we shared the license key with Nikunj Sir and waited to receive the final key from him. 
3. We followed up with Nikunj Sir and received the final license key, which we shared with the client and created a new SQL path. 
4. When we opened the software, it showed only a 1000-user capacity, so we opened the database and checked; we found that 2300 users were showing in the database. 
5. After that, we found that the other database was restored, but it was the only one available in the system. 
6. We coordinated with the client and asked them to give us the active users currently available. 
7. We received the available active 700-800 users, so we updated the users in the database. 
8. After that, the software opened properly and the client checked from their end and updated us that it was working properly.

We checked the door action assignment and explained to them that there is only one lock between two doors and DOTL will connect to only one door; thus, a mail is fired from only one door. solution: We Checked the found that CID is not set on device after repairing so that's why no command were sent. We set the CID on controller and than checked all pending mailed were triggered and hence issue has been resolved.

description_plain: Pls find below details punch not show in system also punch in turnstile and Located area . Month of 30 October 23 and 31 October 23 Empl. 123816 Name : Patel Mehul
comments:
1. First, we checked the Employee Master and found attendance sanctions in the Miscellaneous menu.
2. After that, we checked the attendance sheet and found that the sanctions weren't reflected in it.
3. We took the Zydus server and opened the database, then executed the following query: 
SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code = '' 
SELECT * FROM AttdDetails WHERE EmpID = '' AND AttdDate = ''
4. We discovered that lots of attendance punches had an invalid Process Flag showing X.
5. We updated the Process Flag to P, and all the pending sanctions were cleared and now appear properly in the attendance sheet.
solution:
1. First, we checked the Employee Master and found attendance sanctions in the Miscellaneous menu.
2. After that, we checked the attendance sheet and found that the sanctions weren't reflected in it.
3. We took the Zydus server and opened the database, then executed the following query: 
SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code = '' 
SELECT * FROM AttdDetails WHERE EmpID = '' AND AttdDate = ''
4. We discovered that lots of attendance punches had an invalid Process Flag showing X.
5. We updated the Process Flag to P, and all the pending sanctions were cleared and now appear properly in the attendance sheet.

name: iApp
description_plain: Please note unit 1 both turnstile are not working from last one week . Do the needful action on priority basic . Other 04 Available (Unit 1 both Two turnstile is not working condition )
comments:
1. We discussed with the client and had the turnstile turn off by the client as it was taking too many hits, so we requested that they turn it back on. 
2. We found one turnstile device to be inactive, so we searched its bootloader and found that its device port was defined wrong, so we updated the device port and now it's working fine. 
3. We found that the turnstile was not rotating and it was showing open mode, so we went to access the exception and created a rule for door status, updating the status to arm mode. 
4. After the status changed arm mode, we saved the turnstile device and checked it one by one; now the turnstile is rotating properly.
solution:
1. We discussed with the client and had the turnstile turn off by the client as it was taking too many hits, so we requested that they turn it back on. 
2. We found one turnstile device to be inactive, so we searched its bootloader and found that its device port was defined wrong, so we updated the device port and now it's working fine. 
3. We found that the turnstile was not rotating and it was showing open mode, so we went to access the exception and created a rule for door status, updating the status to arm mode. 
4. After the status changed arm mode, we saved the turnstile device and checked it one by one; now the turnstile is rotating properly.

name: Door Interlocking
description_plain: Kindly depute service engineer for rectification CP-2 Plant Door access interlock is not working urgently
comments:
1. We checked from here and both devices were shown to be inactive in the software.
2. We opened the Zydus server and checked the IP status, which was showing as not active, so we requested the client to check this issue with their plant IT team.
3. After some time, both devices showed as active but the door interlocking system was not working, so we checked with Jatin Sir regarding this case.
4. We wanted to check this case live to ascertain the actual lock issue, so we are waiting for the client's response.
solution:
1. Coordinating with the client, we found that two devices configured with the door interlocking system were not working and were only showing 400 users. 
2. We checked both devices and determined that the IP was working properly, so we took the Zydus server and opened the bootloader application.
3. After that, we updated the firmware for both devices and checked the parameters of the devices.
4. We set the card format and opened the access group, one by one adding the devices already in the group. 
5. We factory reset both devices and performed a user dump on them. After the user dump process was completed, the users were properly showing and both devices were working.
6. The client claimed that the device was working properly, but the door interlocking system was not working, and when punched on the device, the door was stuck.
7. We determined that this was a hardware-related issue, so we shared the format with the RMA team for a chargeable hardware visit to the Ankleshwar location.

description_plain: When a user attempts to add a new card to the system, an error is displayed.
comments:
As per the remote session, we found that the user was not able to punch the device using a card. To resolve the issue, we performed the following steps:

1. Go to Comm App -> Setup -> Card Format -> New and set the following Card Format - Wigand, Reader Type - EM Reader, Wignad Bit - 26, Start Bit - 2 to End Bits - 24 (2C), Start Bit - 2 to End Bits - 26 (3S).

2. Go to Comm App -> Setup -> Set Card Format -> Selected Devices -> Process.

Now, the user is able to punch on the device.

name: Door Interlocking
description_plain: As our door interlocking system is not working properly. The IN punching system got hanged sometime and during that time IN PUNCH not accepted and after power restart same system works ok. Kindly suggest the solution for same.
comments:
We are working on the following tasks:
1. Initially, we had checked what the issue was that the user was facing - they had reported that their device was randomly hanging and access was not working, and upon restarting the device the door interlocking system was working properly.
2. We then discussed the case with Jatin sir and determined that the cause was likely a power-related issue.
3. We advised the client that the cause was power-related, and they would need to replace the device.
4. We then instructed them to get assistance from IT to replace the device and connect it to a laptop, and open the Bootloader application to update the device parameters.
solution:
1. We took remote access and configured the replaced device. 
2. Afterwards, we saved the device in the master, but a waiting page was displayed and it wasn't cleared. 
3. We repeated the action multiple times but still encountered the same issue, and it was also found in the device utility when we checked the device status.
4. Whenever we selected the device and checked the status, the page just kept loading with no result. 
5. We opened the Netxsdownloading application, stopped the downloading, and then restarted it, but still no data was found from the device. 
6. We discussed the case with our internal team and replaced the Netxscontrol version [6.0.0.0026] in the client PC.
7. Afterwards, we registered the STXS file in the CMD command prompt. 
8. One by one, we checked the software, Netxsdownloading exe, and Synchronizer exe. 
9. Then we updated the latest software of the device and checked the device status again in the device utility, after which it was showing properly and the concern had been resolved.

name: iApp
description_plain: The head count is not appearing on the Security Monitor.
comments:
We have taken a remote session with the user and found that they could not see the total headcount in the Security Monitor. To resolve the issue, we have performed the following steps: 
1. We have recreated General Door Groups > I App > Access Control > Device Management > New > Inner Door Group > We have selected Attendance Devices > Outer Door Groups > We have selected Access Control Devices. 
2. We have also recreated the Muster Settings > I App > Access Control > Configuration > Muster Settings > New > Mysore Security > Save. 
3. After that, we have provided rights to access the Security Monitor > I App > Setting > User Configuration > User > Selected Groups > Mysore VMS > Selected Location > Save. 

Since the user wanted only attendance device data in the Security Monitor, we did the following additional steps: 
1. We deleted the Inner Door Groups. 
2. We selected Attendance Devices in the Outer Door Groups. 
3. We deleted the Muster Setting and created a new one with the required configuration. 
4. We provided the appropriate rights to the user. 

Finally, after logging in, the user wanted to view all of the data by department. To do this, we went to Security Monitor > Setting > Look Up Wise > Department > Save.
solution:
After moving attendance device to access control we have added 10.131.82.19 IP Device to security monitor, with below steps.
1. We have recreated General Door Groups > I App > Access Control > Device Management > New > Outer Door Groups >  10.131.82.19 IP Device Selected
2. We have also recreated the Muster Settings > I App > Access Control > Configuration > Muster Settings > New > Mysore Security > Save.
3. After that, we have provided rights to access the Security Monitor > I App > Setting > User Configuration > User > Selected Groups > Mysore VMS > Selected Location > Save

name: No Touch Switch
description_plain: It has noticed that the boom barrier of ZPL main gate is not being open with face punching device whereas face is being read in the device. Kindly check connectivity of this device with boom barrier and resolves the issue. IP No of face reading Device-Entry device IP- 172.31.16.24 Exit device IP-172..31.16.111
comments:
1. We have checked his case with Jatin Sir; the client said that when they punch in the face scribe device, the punch is granted successfully, but the boom barrier does not open. 
2. Following Jatin Sir's instructions, we then set the card format of both Control Panels 1 and 2. However, the same issue was still found after the card format was set. 
3. We checked the face scribe portal, and the device is working fine; we found the issue to be with the boom barrier cable. 
4. We have guided the client and are now waiting for their response.
solution:
1. We coordinated with the client and discovered that when an employee successfully completes a face punch, the boom barrier does not open, and the punches are not recorded in the software.
2. We investigation, we found that the clock data card format was not set in the device.
3. We requested the client to share a photo of the converter, and they promptly provided the photo.
4. Following discussions with Jatin Sir, it was determined that the Wiegand-to-clock data converter is damaged and needs to be replaced.
5. We have discussed the matter with the sales team and transferred the case to them for the preparation of a chargeable quotation for the required hardware parts.

We checked the below scenarios with the help of Setul sir:-
1. We checked and found that customers have applied for leave before the week off and after the week off and after the week off, the application before the week off has been canceled but the sandwich rule came into effect. Is and showing PL leave usage in all Diwali holidays.
2. Holiday should not be applicable in Holiday PL and Sandwich rule should not be applicable for that day.
3. We have examined the leave application and found out on which day the leave application was made and on which day the application was cancelled.
4. After that we open the user log to check the shift roster applied on the next day of application, we filter the location and employee in the user log and we see only one shift roster on 11th November.
5. We take zydus database and execute the below query to check the device transaction:-
select * from ampmaster where code=''
select * from trans where empid=''
6. After that we did not find any miss transaction so we check the created date of holidays in the user log.
7. We found that leaves are created before leave application hence no conclusion.
8. I transfer this case to L2 engineer for further processing.
solution:
1. Leave Deletion (20-11-2023):
A leave applied on 20-11-2023 was deleted, resulting in a deduction of 9 days of leave.

2.Weekoff Removal and Misspunch (19-11-2023):
The weekoff on 19-11-2023 was removed, and an attendance misspunch was applied.

3.Leave Application (20-11-2023):
A new leave was applied on 20-11-2023, but it was only applied for 1 day.

4.Weekoff Addition and Attendance Removal (19-11-2023):
The weekoff on 19-11-2023 was added back, and attendance on the same date was removed.

then issue has been resolved.

SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code='115517'

7. Having approved the application from the sanction list, the coff count now showed properly.

description_plain: When deleted early going on date 25.11.2023. error showing no early hours found on that day.

2. Despite trying to delete the early permission, the same message persisted.
3. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries:
Select * from empmaster where code=''
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='18696' AND attddate='2021/11/17' AND category = 'early';
4.After removing the early permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to change the shift. To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode:
Select * from attdmain where empid='' and attddate=''
5. With this adjustment, the employee was able to change the shift as needed."

comments:
1. A client claimed that the report on in-out transactions data was not displaying information for a specific utility contract company name.
2. We investigation, we opened the in-out report for turnstile devices, selected all devices, and generated the report. However, we noticed that not all transactions were being displayed.
3. Further examination revealed that in the month of November, we replaced the device from 2c to 3s. Consequently, the old device names were changed to "dummy," and these devices were not included in the report.
4. To address this issue, we regenerated the report, including the selection of dummy devices. Additionally, we filtered the report by the contract company name.
5. After these adjustments, we regenerated the report, confirming that all data, including transactions related to the dummy devices and the specified contract company, were now displaying correctly.
6. We shared the updated report with the client and confirmed that all data was now appearing as expected.

description_plain: User punch data is visible but in remarks it is showing absent
comments:
During a remote session with the user, we identified an issue with the employee's punch data, which inaccurately displayed absences despite the employee correctly punching in and out.

3. So we suggest to off the free-scan mode and change the card mode to card+finger.

name: iApp
ticket_title: Add devices and create access groups
description_plain: The client wants to add 12 new devices in Iapp and create four access groups for those devices.
comments:
As per the client's request, we added 12 devices to the access control system by following these steps:

1. Open the command prompt and find the ping of each device using its IP address.
2. Access the boot loader and search for the device using its IP address. Enter the server port and server IP in the boot loader.
3. Return to the command prompt and ping the IP address again to check if the device is online.
4. Navigate to iapp > access control > device manager > device.
5. Add a new device.
6. Set the card format by going to iapp > device operation > card format.
Repeat the entire process for all 12 devices.

Afterward, the user wants to create four access groups for the devices. To achieve this, follow these steps:
1. Go to iapp > access control > device manager > access group > new.
2. Create the access groups according to the client's guidance.
Repeat the entire process for all four access groups.

comments: client leave the office his not able to provide the remote session.
solution:
The client requested to add 7 devices in NetxsControl and dump the data. We followed these steps: 
1. Checked pending data > verified the reader > initiated downloading > selected controller.
2. Started data downloading in NetxsDownload > commenced the download process.
3. In NetxsControl > Controller Utility > selected device > checked transaction status. 
4. Sent the command > obtained controller status > verified device online status; if online, sent the dump database command. 
5. Set card format. 
6. Created ODBC for NetxsControl. Employee ID 9148 faced door access issues.
 We perform the entire above process for all the devices.

The client reported that employee ID 1948 is unable to access any of the doors. We have granted access to all authorized doors, but they are still experiencing issues accessing them.
Upon investigation, we discovered that the client mistakenly assigned the resigned employee's card to EmpID 1948, who had not surrendered the card. To resolve this, we surrendered the card from the resigned employee and reassigned it to EmpID 9148. 

According to the client's request, we create an access group.

description_plain: Kindly refer the screenshot attached for the OT approval pending at HR/ Admin for the following Employee. Name: Dilip Sindha Emp.ID: 141940 From Date:23/11/23 To Date: 30/11/23 Total OT hours: 32 hrs Please look into the matter and resolve.
comments: We checked the overtime/coff application, and all applications are currently pending at HR/Admin. The overtime hierarchy appears to be in order, and we verified that the approval status is active. To address this issue, we plan to discuss the case with the client on Monday.
solution:
We checked the following details and provided a solution to the client:
1. Initially, we opened the overtime/coff details and discovered that all overtime applications were going to pending at HR/Admin.
2. Subsequently, we accessed the user hierarchy, specifically the overtime hierarchy. We filtered by employee ID and found that primary approval and manager were already defined in the overtime hierarchy for employees with an active status.
3. To investigate further, we examined the user logs to check for changes in the overtime hierarchy after the application. We found that before the application, no approvals were defined in the overtime hierarchy. However, after the application was submitted, approvals were defined.
4. According to the overtime sanctioning rule, if approvals are not defined when the application is created, the applications go to HR for final approval.

comments:
IAPP is not functioning across all Zydus locations, and we are currently addressing the following tasks:
1. We investigation, we observed that IAPP is not working, and the waiting page is continuously displayed.
2. To identify the root cause, we examined the Zydus server. Upon accessing the server, we opened the task manager to check CPU utilization.
3. Identifying that CPU utilization was at 100%, causing the application to run very slowly, we accessed services and halted the Spectra Worker service.
4. After a 5-minute wait, we accessed IIS and stopped the IIS manager. Waiting for an additional 5-10 minutes, the CPU process stabilized, allowing us to start services one by one.
5. Initially, we restarted the IIS manager and, after some time, initiated the Spectra Worker process.
6. With the CPU now stable, we noticed that the software was still running slowly. To pinpoint the issue, we accessed the database and executed the following CPU utilization query:
Query :- 
SELECT r.cpu_time AS cpu, s.login_name,
DATEDIFF(SECOND, last_request_start_time, getdate()) AS Seconds,
s.session_id AS SessionID, blocking_session_id AS Blocking,
SUBSTRING( st.text, (statement_start_offset/2)+1,
                                           ABS(((CASE statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text)
                                           ELSE statement_end_offset
                                           END - statement_start_offset)/2) + 1 )) AS statement_text,
OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME (objectid , r.database_id ) as SchemaName
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(sql_handle) AS st
order by Seconds desc
7. The query revealed that one process was consuming 600000+ CPU. We allowed the process to complete, and after 5 minutes, it finished. The software is now functioning properly.

name: iApp
description_plain: Site head Mr. Adamsufi Sultan data is showing wrong . At 18:43 he exited the plant but the system shows him inside 820415,Adamsufi Y Sultan,BIOCHEM Plant Zydus Healthcare Limited,19 Dec 2023 18:43:07 Pl look and do the needful
comments:
1. Discussion with Client:
Identify the security monitor headcount concern.
Note that Mr. Adamsufi Sultan has already left the plant but is still showing in the headcount.
2. Transaction and Punch Check:
Verify that transactions and punches are recorded accurately.
Focus on checking the in-out related punch data.
3. Identify Punch Issue:
Confirm that both punches (in and out) are recorded correctly.
Note any discrepancies that might be causing the headcount concern.
4. Discussion with Setulsir:
Engage with Setulsir (assuming Setulsir is a relevant authority or individual) to discuss the identified issue.
Share the findings related to Mr. Adamsufi Sultan's exit but still being present in the security monitor headcount.
Collaborate on a solution to correct the issue.
solution:
First Concern:
1. We installed the security monitor application and verified the data for today on the turnstile and attendance devices. The plant head's information was accurately reflected on both devices.
2. In the user logs, we identified changes to the muster settings, where new muster points were created as per the client's requirements.
3. Subsequently, we edited an employee in the employee master page and checked the miscellaneous page to review the employee's transactions on that day.
4. Upon investigation, we discovered that the turnstile out punch was recorded on the device, but the security monitor displayed the wrong information.
5. To clarify the discrepancy, we generated the employee's transaction history, revealing that the employee initially punched out on the turnstile device. Later, an in punch was registered on the attendance device, causing the security monitor to count it as an in punch.
6. Through continuous monitoring, we found that employees consistently punch out on the turnstile device before punching in on the attendance device.
7. Upon advising the client about this process, they verified the CCTV camera footage, confirming that the employee had indeed left the premises and subsequently punched in at the car parking attendance device."
Second Concern:
1. An employee raised a concern about being categorized as a visitor in the security monitor, while the visitor count is reflected in the contract master.
2. We clarified that 'visitor' is not a user type, and Zydus offers three user types: Employee, Contract Workforce, and Apprentice.
3. The visitor card is assigned to the contract master, leading to the display of visitor count in the contract workforce menu. This is expected behavior based on the assignment in the contract master."

name: UniStamp 2C
description_plain: The canteen device is displaying an incorrect time, leading to punching errors. We need to correct this issue to ensure accurate time tracking. Please address the time discrepancy on the canteen device to prevent any further punching errors.
comments:
1. The client reported an issue with the canteen device, stating that the punching system displays an error indicating an invalid time zone, and the time on the device is inaccurate.
2. Upon investigation, we found that the canteen device is offline in the software database menu.
3. To troubleshoot, we accessed the Zydus server to check device connectivity. The device's IP was successfully pinged in the CMD, indicating proper activity.
4. Further examination in the bootloader application revealed that the 'unistamp 2C' device had an incorrect server port setting, displaying as 13456.
5. To rectify this, we updated the canteen 2C device's server port to 9991 and reconfigured the device.
6. As a result, the device is now online, and the time is displaying accurately. The reported issues with the invalid time zone and time display have been successfully addressed."

description_plain: Pls look in below screen shot, I have assign 2 CL & 2 SL for New Employee Mr. Patel Aenal Rameshbhai (143004). But system taking 4 CL & 4 SL. Pls resolve this.
comments:

2. Upon further inspection of the employee's attendance sheet, it was observed that the leave balance is showing double.

name: ARSWin-Net
description_plain: We can't add user to the system.
comments:
1. A user is encountering an OCX error when attempting to add another user, necessitating remote access since the error is specific to the client's PC.
2. After gaining remote access to the client's PC, we examined the stxscontrol DLL file in the system32 folder and confirmed that its version is correct.
3. Utilizing the command prompt (cmd), we registered the stxs file with the following command:
cd..
cd regsvr32
regsvr32 stxscontrol.dll
4. Although the error was initially resolved after registration, it reappeared upon closing and reopening the software.
5. Further investigation revealed that other OCX files were contributing to the issue. Consequently, we registered 7-8 OCX files, resolving the error permanently.

description_plain: trying to addition finger print of employees in our attendance system but system not asking for finger print while employee punching
comments: As per our telephonic conversation, you mentioned that you would connect with me in 10 minutes. Please contact me at 8989674797. I am waiting.
solution:
We initiated an AnyDesk remote session with the client to enable card and finger access in two locations. The first location, F2, involves two devices, while the second location, OSD, has four devices. Additionally, we were tasked with setting the date/time format. To address these requirements, we performed the following operations:

1. Navigated to the C drive > netserverutility.
2. Selected the specified location.
3. Chose the controller and accessed 'Get Parameters.'
4. Modified the reader parameters by enabling 'FP' to 'Yes' and setting 'FP Compulsory' to 'Yes.'
5. Set parameters

Afterward, we proceeded to set the date and time:

1. Opened ARSWin-Net.
2. Accessed the Reader Utility.
3. Set the date and time.
4. Processed the changes.

With the help of Mr. Katul Sir

ticket_title: transfer fingers one to another device
description_plain: Client wants to transfer fingerprints from one device to another, modify the root fingerprint, and configure the system to grant access only with fingerprint.
comments:
In the remote session conducted as per the client's request, we initiated the fingerprint transfer process from one device to another by executing the following steps: Navigate to ARSwin > Reader > Utility > Select Reader > Set Finger > Choose the destination device > Select Department > Process.

Furthermore, the client desired the modification of the root fingerprint on five devices. To achieve this, we performed the subsequent steps: Access ARSwin > Reader > Utility > Select Reader > Get Finger > Process > Return to Select Reader > Choose Device > Delete All Fingerprints > Process > Return to Select Reader > Choose Device > Set Finger > Process.

Finally, the client requested configuring the system to allow access solely through fingerprint authentication.

1. Navigated to the C drive > netserverutility.
2. Selected the specified location.
3. Chose the controller and accessed 'Get Parameters.'
4. Modified the reader parameters by enabling 'FP' to 'Yes' and setting 'FP Compulsory' to 'Yes.'
5. Set parameters

description_plain: Canteen guest punching card is not working. Pl find out the root cause. Also need to revive the card.
comments: Please share the card number and employee ID so that we can check from our end as well.

6. We shared these findings with the client and recommended reassigning the cards to the relevant code.

description_plain: iAPP Working Very Slow
comments:
1. We investigation, we found that iApp is working slowly. To diagnose the issue, we accessed the Zydus server to check CPU utilization.
2. In the task manager, CPU consumption is within the acceptable range (under 50%).
3. To identify which process is consuming more CPU, we executed the following query:
4. Query :- SELECT r.cpu_time AS cpu, s.login_name,
DATEDIFF(SECOND, last_request_start_time, getdate()) AS Seconds,
s.session_id AS SessionID, blocking_session_id AS Blocking,
SUBSTRING( st.text, (statement_start_offset/2)+1,
                                           ABS(((CASE statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text)
                                           ELSE statement_end_offset
                                           END - statement_start_offset)/2) + 1 )) AS statement_text,
OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME (objectid , r.database_id ) as SchemaName
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(sql_handle) AS st
order by Seconds desc
5. The query revealed that two processes were consuming more CPU. We terminated these processes, and iApp is now working properly.

name: iApp
description_plain: As per trail mail he was 5 days worked on Diwali holiday, but c-off not balance not seen in system. Please do the need full. Pratap Harde, 131702.
comments:
1. The client has reported that an employee worked overtime on Diwali holiday, and according to the overtime policy, compensatory off (COFF) should have been generated. However, the COFF is not generated, and the COFF balance is currently showing as ZERO.
2. We reviewing the employee's attendance sheet, we observed that overtime applications were approved, and the user worked for 8:00 hours in addition to the regular hours, as per the policy that mandates the generation of one COFF for every 8:00 hours of extra work on a holiday.
3. Despite the approved overtime applications, there is no COFF balance visible. To rectify this, we need to delete and reapply the overtime. Unfortunately, this cannot be done due to the completion of the payroll cycle.
4. It is recommended to discuss this case with Mr. Setul for further action and resolution.
solution:
1. Compensation for the employee was not generated, prompting a discussion with Setul sir. To resolve the issue, we decided to reopen the month closure cycle.
2. The month closure cycle was reopened with the updated date, allowing us to edit the attendance records.
3. Subsequently, all overtime applications for the 5 days of Diwali holidays were canceled.
4. We executed the following query to change the late status to "P":
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='18696' AND attddate='2021/11/17' AND category = 'overtime';
5. After the late status change in the database, the applications now show as pending approval in the application sanctioning module.
6. We navigated to the application sanction page and approved 2 out of 5 applications. A warning message indicated that 3 applications already had compensatory off (COFF) utilized, so only 2 applications were approved.
7. Following the approvals, the COFF values were accurately reflected in the attendance sheet.

3. After verifying IP connectivity and confirming successful pinging, I opened the bootloader application to search for the device.
4. It was identified that the firmware was outdated, prompting us to update the device firmware. Following the update, the device was restarted from the device manager.
5. Post-restart, I observed that the machine data was not cleared, and certain commands were showing as pending:
Select * from  controllermaster where ipaddr=''
Select * from machinedata where controllerid='' and status='P'
6. To address this issue, I advised the client to perform a physical restart of the device and then check its status.

description_plain: Need to replace the canteen device because the old device is not working.
comments:
1. The user needs to replace the canteen device because the old CM800 device is not working. The new device is Bioscribe 3S.
2. First, we check the old IP address of the device and guide the client to insert the IP address, subnet mask, and gateway into the device.
3. After confirming that the device IP is working, we configure the device parameters such as server port and server IP.
4. We check the firmware and find that it is an attendance device, so we update the canteen device with the latest firmware.
5. Next, I open the software, edit the details of the old device by removing the name and IP address, and add the new Bioscribe 3S device.
6. I add the new device, configure the canteen device parameters, and the command is executed successfully.
7. After that, we perform a factory reset on the device and have the user dump information onto it.
8. When a user punches on the device, a printer disconnected error occurs. I guide them through the steps to disable BLE printer settings: 
Unlock the device --> go to Network Parameters --> BLE Printer Settings --> disable.
9. A card format error appears again, and I guide them to the card format menu to set the card format to prox.
10. Now, the device is working properly.

SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code='115517' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='18696' AND attddate='2021/11/17' AND category = 'late'; 
delete FROM adjustapply WHERE userid='18696' AND attddate='2021/11/17' AND category = 'late';

Select * from attdmain where empid='' and attddate='2023/12/12' 
4. Following the removal of early hours, we reprocessed the attendance sheet, and now the data is displaying correctly.

comments:
Find the steps below: 
1. When we open the registration page and attempt to save the gate pass, we receive an error Unique key constraint. 
2. To check the visitor count mismatch issue, we take the Zydus server and open the SQL dbx. 
3. We execute the following query in the database: 
-- SELECT MAX(id) FROM VISITOR --459915 
-- SELECT * FROM Sequences WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE'%visitor%' --459914 
4. We find that the visitor count sequence is mismatched, so we update the sequence with the following query: 
--UPDATE SEQUENCES SET LastSequence = '' WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE'%visitor%' 5. Now that the sequence is updated, the VMS is working properly.

3. After restarting the device, I proceeded to update its firmware to the latest version.

Select * from controllermaster where ipaddr=''
Select * from machinedata where controllerid='' and status=''
6. I found 50 machine data entries showing as pending, and to resolve this, I executed the query:
Delete from machinedata where controllerid='' and status=''
7. After deleting the pending machine data, I restarted the device from the bootloader application and successfully saved the device configuration from the software.
8. Subsequently, I performed a factory reset on the device and initiated the user dump process.
9. Once the user dump process was completed, I configured the card format of the device, and now the device is operating correctly.

description_plain: Create new process year for other company.
comments: User will connect after lunch
solution:
As per the  remote session with the user, we observed their need to create a new year for their second company. To accomplish this, we followed the below steps in ARS Win:

Navigated to File > Select Company > Create New process year > Save.
Post the creation of the new year, the user reported the absence of data for December 30th, 31st, and January 1st in the spreadsheet.

Upon investigating the ARSwindata.log, we noticed that there were no punch logs available for the mentioned dates. In an attempt to troubleshoot, we also examined another log file within the user's ARSWin but found no relevant data.

Subsequently, we accessed the log files on the server system and examined the netdata.log. Here, we identified all the necessary logs for the mentioned dates. To resolve the issue, we extracted the logs for December 30th, 31st, and January 1st, consolidated them into a new text file, and created a new log file with the available log details.

We then replaced the existing log file in the ARS Win software with this new log file containing the missing data. Upon initiating the download process again, all the missing punch data became available and were successfully retrieved.

description_plain: We have some overtime hierarchy assign related issue and I have discussed this issue with Jignesh Sir, he suggest for you.
comments:

3. Upon filtering employees by the client, it became evident that an incorrect approval was defined in the overtime hierarchy.
4. I proceeded to guide the client on how overtime hierarchy functions and provided training accordingly.
5. During the process of defining the client's approval, an error surfaced indicating that a lower level was already defined. Upon inspection, I identified that the approval was wrongly defined. 
6. I then guided the client on the removal of the incorrect approval and instructed them on defining a new approval within the overtime hierarchy.

name: BioScribe 3S
description_plain: Our hardware engineer, Mr. Nirav Patel, visited the Ankleshwar location and is tasked with installing new turnstile devices.
comments:
1. I discussed with Niravbhai to understand the actual device configuration. The old devices, Bio Scribe 2c, were found to be inactive. Subsequently, new Bio Scribe 3s devices were configured in their place.
2. Following this, I obtained the IP addresses of the first two configured devices. I checked their connectivity to the Zydus server, confirming that they were active and functioning properly.
3. Using the bootloader application, I configured the server IP and server port for both devices. I then proceeded to open the software.
4. In the devices menu, I edited the settings of the two old devices, marking them as inactive. Simultaneously, I added two new devices with the same IP addresses, ensuring that commands were successfully communicated to both.
5. Moving to the access groups menu, I added the two new devices and performed a factory reset on them.
6. I initiated the user dump process and set the card format on both devices.
7. While waiting for Niravbhai to install the remaining devices, I prepared to configure the pending devices once the installations were completed.
solution:
I configured a total of 6 devices: 4 access turnstile devices and 2 attendance devices.
1. First two devices already mention on previous comment.
2. The old devices, Bio Scribe 2c, were found to be inactive. Subsequently, new Bio Scribe 3s devices were configured in their place. 
3. Following this, I obtained the IP addresses of the first two configured devices. I checked their connectivity to the Zydus server, confirming that they were active and functioning properly. 
4. Using the bootloader application, I configured the server IP and server port for both devices. I then proceeded to open the software. 
5. In the devices menu, I edited the settings of the two old devices, marking them as inactive. Simultaneously, I added two new devices with the same IP addresses, ensuring that commands were successfully communicated to both. 
6. Moving to the access groups menu, I added the two new devices and performed a factory reset on them. 
7. I initiated the user dump process and set the card format on both devices.
8. I checked all the 40 access groups and removed unwanted turnstile devices from them.
9. The client needed to configure 2 new attendance devices. After the installation was completed, I checked the Zydus server and updated the firmware of both devices.
10. After updating, I opened the software and added the new two Bioscribe 2C attendance devices.
11. I performed a factory reset on the devices, dumped user data onto them, and also set the card format for each device.
12. Saved the device settings in attendance settings and edited all the attendance access groups to include both devices.

name: iApp
description_plain: It is being noticed that few employees are taking breakfast & Tea in ‘A’ shift and the same person is taking breakfast & team in ‘G’ shift also. Therefore he is availing two breakfast & tea in a day, which is not as per the company policy. Request you to put some control so that second punching should not be accepted by the device. Hope will get solution on this.
comments:
1. The client has reported that employees are able to use tea two times for both A and B shifts, which is not permissible. The client requests a restriction to allow only one-time tea consumption.
2. Upon investigation, I opened the item group, and since there are 7-8 item groups available, I require a list of employees who need the restriction on the tea item.
3. I have requested the user to share examples so that I can check and address the issue from my end as well.
solution:
1. Upon investigating the reported case, the client highlighted that employees can punch for tea twice during two shifts, despite the system allowing only one tea punch per employee.
2. I accessed the employee master and navigated to the canteen assign access group, where I discovered the presence of duplicate item groups assigned to the employees.
3. Upon editing each item group, I identified that both item groups had tea available, allowing employees to punch for tea twice.
4. I have shared these details with the client and requested them to remove the unnecessary duplicate item group to resolve the issue.

description_plain: Overtime done for the 2nd Dec and 3rd Dec but coff only generated quantity is only 1. Please check on urgent basis. emp id - 16524
comments:
1. Opening the attendance sheet, we found that overtime application had already been approved, but the coff count was showing as zero. 
2. We discovering the bug, we immediately solved the issue due to the pending payroll process. 
3. Therefore, we cancelled the overtime application in the attendance sheet. 
4. To check the application status, we executed the following query: 
SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code='115517' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='18696' AND attddate='2021/11/17' AND category = 'mispunch'; 
5. The last status for the application was showing as 'G', so we updated it as 'P'. 
6. Upon reprocessing the attendance sheet, the application was now showing as pending at the approver. 
7. Having approved the application from the sanction list, the coff count now showed properly.

name: iApp
description_plain: This is regarding the system error one of the employee who is reporting in “A” shift and system is showing A shift as well as in night shift also on the same day, still night shift is yet not started. Need to rectify such kind of issue.
comments: I checked from here and found that employee id not showing so i request to the client that please share the employee id so i can check from here also.
solution:
1. The client reported an issue where an employee's punch-out was not recorded in the system. To investigate, I retrieved the employee ID and edited the employee master.
2. Subsequently, I accessed the miscellaneous menu and checked the transactions. It was discovered that the punch-out was recorded in the system but was timestamped in the late night.
3. Further investigation was conducted by opening the transactions view and filtering based on location and employee ID. Data for the date of 11th Jan was found.
4. Upon comparing the card ID, it was noted that all the cards used matched the ones assigned to the employee. I have shared these findings with the client for their reference.

name: iApp
description_plain: VMS not working please check ,
comments:
1. Upon investigation, I observed that the iapp is not functioning, and the page is continuously loading, preventing the software from opening.
2. To diagnose the issue, I accessed the server and opened the task manager, discovering that the CPU usage had spiked to 90% and was causing the software to operate slowly.
3. Subsequently, I executed the query below to assess CPU utilization:
SELECT r.cpu_time AS cpu, s.login_name,
DATEDIFF(SECOND, last_request_start_time, getdate()) AS Seconds,
s.session_id AS SessionID, blocking_session_id AS Blocking,
SUBSTRING( st.text, (statement_start_offset/2)+1,
                                           ABS(((CASE statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text)
                                           ELSE statement_end_offset
                                           END - statement_start_offset)/2) + 1 )) AS statement_text,
OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME (objectid , r.database_id ) as SchemaName
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(sql_handle) AS st
order by Seconds desc
4. Despite not identifying any process consuming excessive resources, I decided to halt the Spectra worker process and subsequently stop IIS.
5. After a brief pause, I restarted both processes, and the iapp began functioning properly.

SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code='26885'

delete FROM adjustapply WHERE userid='1754' AND attddate='2023/12/05' AND category = 'late';
